input.question: What is the point of payday loans? Why can't you cash a paycheck immediately?
input.ground_truth: A payday loan is like getting paid early. When you get the loan, you haven't actually gotten paid from your job yet but you need money and you pay the loan back plus interest when you get paid from your job.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: What is the point of payday loans? Why can't you cash a paycheck immediately?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you have a big cookie that your mom gives you at the end of the week. But you really, really want some candy *right now* before you get the cookie. 

A payday loan is like asking a friend to give you some candy now, but you have to promise to give them more candy (plus a little extra) when you get your big cookie at the end of the week.

You can't cash your paycheck immediately sometimes because your job needs a little time to make sure the money is really there and to put it in your account. It’s like waiting for your cookie to bake in the oven—it takes a little time before you can eat it!
